entwurf.thema: Claude Projects: what the sources support, free versus paid

teile.name: Repeating context
teile.text: Re-explaining your background every chat gets old. Claude Projects keeps documents and context together, and free accounts get it.
teile.szene: Black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk, rubbing his temple in frustration, medium shot, warm lamp light, painted open-world-game poster style.

teile.name: What a project is
teile.text: A project is a workspace with its own chats and knowledge base. Upload documents; add instructions like a formal tone.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center article on projects, showing the description of self-contained workspaces with chat histories and knowledge bases, clear close crop of the documentation text.

teile.name: Free limit
teile.text: Free accounts can create up to five projects. Hypothetically, one could hold work notes, another your study files.
teile.szene: Presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses arranges five separate cardboard boxes in a neat row on a wooden desk, warm lamp light, medium close shot, painted game poster style.

teile.name: What paying adds
teile.text: So where does paying come in? RAG knowledge is only on paid plans: Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center passage stating that enhanced project knowledge with RAG is only available to users with paid Claude plans, tight crop on that text.

teile.name: What RAG does
teile.text: Paid projects scale to large amounts of content through RAG. The sources give no prices; check Anthropic's pricing page.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center passage about paid projects scaling to handle large amounts of content through Retrieval Augmented Generation, clear close crop of the documentation text.

teile.name: Honest limits
teile.text: Projects draw from your plan's usage, like any other Claude use. Free covers five projects; RAG needs paying.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center note stating that projects draw from your plan's usage like any other use of Claude, close crop of the documentation text.

teile.name: Ending
teile.text: No more re-explaining. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses leans back in his desk chair, arms crossed, calm thoughtful smile, tidy desk, wide shot, evening light, painted game poster style.

entwurf.beschreibung: Claude Projects are workspaces with their own chats, documents and instructions. Free accounts get up to five, while RAG project knowledge is on paid plans only. Prices aren't in the sources.
